title: Sentinel prompt sharding and delta-eval orchestration for config-triggered regressions
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Configuration changes (routing policies, quantization profiles, and model variant swaps) occasionally introduce subtle quality regressions that only manifest on a small subset of prompts. Current eval gating runs full golden suites on every config change which is slow and noisy for high-change flows.

Goal: Implement a lightweight, shardable "sentinel" prompt orchestration that: 1) shards trusted prompt pools into compact sentinel sets per tenant/workload; 2) auto-triggers delta-evals on config/model changes and only escalates to full golden runs when sentinel metrics cross thresholds; 3) preserves strict access controls and auditability for golden artifacts and shard mappings.

Key deliverables: 
- Sentinal prompt sharding service (daemon + cron) that materializes per-project sentinel sets with stable fingerprints and TTL-based rotation.
- Delta-eval orchestration pipeline that takes a config-change event, computes impacted shard set (by model, tokenizer, seq-len profile), launches parallel lightweight evals, and aggregates signal to produce pass/warn/fail.
- Attestation ledger for shard snapshots (SHA256 hash chain + signer metadata) stored alongside existing golden registry so changes are traceable and can be rolled back.
- RBAC enforcement on shard generation and attestation signing (only stewards + infra CI can sign published sentinels).
- Canary escalation policy: failing sentinel -> schedule targeted expanded evals (10x larger sample) -> if expanded fails, create regression alert and open PM/SE circuits.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Sentinel sets reduce average gating runtime from ~45m to <8m for config-triggered checks on 95% of changes.
- False-negative rate (missing real regression) < 0.5% measured against retrospective incident corpus.
- All sentinel snapshots have signed attestations and appear in the golden registry UI with version and signer.
- RBAC rules are enforced in the service; unauthorized publish attempts are rejected and audited.

Non-goals: 
- This ticket does not replace the full golden-run workflow; it is an intermediate gating optimization.
- This does not change user-facing prompt curation tooling UX (that is a separate PM ticket).

Trade-offs considered: 
- Sample size vs. sensitivity: smaller sentinels reduce cost but increase missed regressions. We will tune with retrospective A/B tests.
- Precomputed vs. on-demand shard generation: precompute nightly with TTL to bound flakiness; allow on-demand re-shard for major model changes.

Implementation notes: 
- Shard selection will use stratified sampling by intent cluster, token length bucket, and historical failure hotspot. We will leverage existing embedding clusters from the eval-catalog.
- Store snapshot metadata in existing golden registry table with new columns: sentinel_tag, signer, fingerprint, base_corpus_hash, ttl_expiry.
- Orchestration uses Kubernetes Job pool with concurrency limits and backoff; results written to eval-results S3 prefix and pushed to the console metrics endpoint for dashboards.

Telemetry & dashboards: 
- New dashboard cards: sentinel_pass_rate (per-project), sentinel_latency_histogram, escalation_count, time_to_escalation.
- Alert rules: escalation_count > 3 in 1h for a single project -> P1 Pager.

Rollout plan: 
1) Alpha: internal projects only, collect signal and tune thresholds (2 weeks).
2) Beta: opt-in for customers with Dedicated/Dedicated+Private (4 weeks).
3) GA: on-by-default for config-change gating with opt-out toggle.

comments: 2026-03-01 - Ravi K: Initial spike completed; prototype generates sentinel shards and runs lightweight evals against a single model family. Observed 6x speedup on average. Next: integrate attestation signing and RBAC checks.
2026-03-03 - Maya Chen (PM): Good direction. Please include a clear fallback so that a mis-signed sentinel doesn't block production rollouts. Also add telemetry for false-neg rate estimation.
2026-03-05 - Design review by Linh Tran: Shared initial UI mock for golden-registry view showing sentinel fingerprint and signer. Minor UX ask: make TTL visible inline.

2026-03-08 - Security review (Kai Hoffman): Suggested HSM-backed signing for attestations when we move to customer-visible sentinels; for alpha use CI signer with rotation. Also flagged data retention compliance for per-tenant shards.

2026-03-12 - Ravi K: Implemented signed snapshot metadata write to registry; pushing PR for review (see link). Started canary escalation policy tests on infra-dev, observed one false-positive that triggered expanded evals — tuning threshold downward.
